title: 第9章 掌控梦境契约规则第10章 新的梦境梦境联动
slug: 虚实梦境之主从死后开始
content_zh:
就在孟天想着，要如何将死亡空间拉到近前，或者将经理办公室梦境空间，移动到死亡空间面前的时候。
似乎感应到了他的心意，或者说两者本就一体，他忽地感受到一股力量，自死亡空间投射而来。
这一方梦境空间，本能的就是有些排斥。
只不过，其力量已经极其微弱，再加上孟天察觉之后，立即调动自身力量，以及对于经理办公室的掌控，将这股反抗与排斥镇压。
因此，死亡空间的力量，轻松突破空间降临，然后以孟天为中心，向着周围扩散开来，迅速的同化着每一处空间。
感受着这一情况，孟天不禁暗自呢喃。
原来，他还可以接引死亡空间力量降临呢。
渐渐的，死亡空间的力量，遍布了经理办公室。
本来，孟天还想要操控着同化外界梦境空间呢。
然而，死亡空间的力量刚刚扩散出去，外界的梦境空间，就轰然崩溃，化作点点梦境之力消散了。
死亡空间的力量，能够轻易的同化经理办公室，那是因为这里的一切，都被孟天掌控了。
有他作为媒介，死亡空间的力量可以轻松介入。
哪怕力量冲突导致空间波动，孟天也能在短时间之内，暂时将其镇压稳定住。
其它的梦境空间就不同了。
本身就在剧烈的波动，又没有镇压物品与力量，死亡空间力量的介入，立即就将其最后一点平衡打破，瞬间崩溃。
看着寸寸崩溃的梦境空间，孟天不禁心中暗叹。
虽然已经有所预料，但还是有些感到可惜。
不过…
孟天看着梦境空间崩溃化作的梦境力量，当即心中一动。
“嗡~！”

经理办公室所在空间，瞬间爆发一股同源吸力，将那无数的梦境能量吞噬一空，这使得经理办公室所在梦境空间，更强了三分。
做完这些之后，孟天这才来到经理办公室门前，轻轻推开了房门。
门外一片虚无，漆黑如墨的死亡空间悬浮，宛如无底深渊，又如吞噬一切的黑洞。
孟天站在死亡空间之外，就像来自地狱的魔神。
看着打开房门的分身，孟天不禁咧嘴一笑。
这一次，当真是收获无数。
下一刻，分身猛的疾冲而出。
在冲出房门的瞬间，他能够明显的感受到，似乎穿透了一层无形薄膜。
不过，双方一体，那层薄膜并未对其进行阻挡。
瞬间，分身便扑到了孟天近前，化作了一团庞大能量，融入了他的身体。
“唔~，嗯哼！”
庞大的力量在体内炸开，孟天瞬间崩裂开一道道的伤口，鲜血汩汩流出，很快便在脚下积出两三米的血泊。
不过与此同时，他的等级也是开始飞速提升。
c2级别的20点能量须臾而就，孟天瞬间突破。
content_en:
Just when Meng Tian was thinking about how to bring the death space closer, or move the dream space of the manager's office in front of the death space.
It seemed that he sensed his thoughts, or that the two were one and the same. He suddenly felt a force projected from the dead space.
This dream space is instinctively repulsive.
However, its power was extremely weak, and after Meng Tian noticed it, he immediately mobilized his own power and control of the manager's office to suppress this resistance and rejection.
Therefore, the power of the dead space easily breaks through the space and descends, and then spreads to the surroundings with Meng Tian as the center, quickly assimilating every space.
Feeling this situation, Meng Tian couldn't help but murmur to himself.
It turns out that he can also attract the power of dead space to come.
Gradually, the power of dead space spread throughout the manager's office.
Originally, Meng Tian wanted to control and assimilate the dream space of the outside world.
However, as soon as the power of the dead space spread out, the dream space in the outside world collapsed, turning into little bits of dream power and dissipating.
The power of the dead space can easily assimilate into the manager's office. That's because everything here is controlled by Meng Tian.
With him as a medium, the power of Dead Space can easily intervene.
Even if the conflict of forces causes space fluctuations, Meng Tian can temporarily suppress and stabilize them in a short period of time.
Other dream spaces are different.
It was fluctuating violently, and there were no suppressing items or power. The intervention of the dead space power immediately broke its last balance and collapsed instantly.
Looking at the crumbling dream space, Meng Tian couldn't help but sigh in his heart.
Although I had expected it, I still felt a little pity.
But…
Meng Tian looked at the dream power transformed from the collapse of the dream space, and his heart immediately moved.
"Buzz~!"
The space where the manager's office is located instantly bursts out with a homologous suction force, swallowing up the countless dream energy. This makes the dream space where the manager's office is located three points stronger.
After doing this, Meng Tian came to the door of the manager's office and gently opened the door.
There is nothingness outside the door, and the dark space of death is suspended, like a bottomless abyss, and like a black hole that swallows everything.
Meng Tian stood outside the dead space, like a demon from hell.
Looking at the clone who opened the door, Meng Tian couldn't help but grin.
This time, I really gained a lot.
The next moment, the clone rushed out fiercely.
The moment he rushed out of the room, he could clearly feel that an invisible film had penetrated.
However, the two sides were one, and the film did not block it.
In an instant, the clone rushed in front of Meng Tian, ​​turned into a huge ball of energy, and merged into his body.
"Uh~, huh huh!"
Huge power exploded in his body, and Meng Tian's wounds instantly burst open. Blood flowed out, and soon there was a pool of blood of two to three meters under his feet.
But at the same time, his level also began to increase rapidly.
The 20 points of energy at the c2 level were obtained in an instant, and Meng Tian broke through instantly.
